system.biography:
Background

Menele (born Menele of Greece, c. 1240 B.C.) is a 4th-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} Methuselah, Embraced in antiquity by the philosopher Troile after the fall of Troy. He helped found Carthage as a utopian city of Kindred and kine living in harmony, and served as its envoy until Rome and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue}/@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} alliance destroyed the city. He has warred for millennia against the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} Methuselah Helena ("Portia"), his opposite number and rival for control of Chicago; both fell into torpor roughly 250 years ago after a climactic battle near Fort Dearborn and have remained torpid ever since, directing the city's Kindred through Blood Bonds, Dominate, and unwitting proxies. Menele controls Chicago's anarchs indirectly through his childe and Blood-Bound thrall Critias ("the Doctor," a Brujah primogen who has no idea of the bond or of Menele's continued existence) and through Dominated intermediaries. His extra level of Auspex lets him remain dimly aware of city events even while torpid, and his extra level of Dominate lets his agents act on his will with only a touch, no eye contact required.

Roleplaying Hints

Menele is in torpor and does not act directly; his influence surfaces only through the actions of Critias and other unwitting agents. If ever roused, he is patient, philosophical, and utterly ruthless in service to his long game against Helena.

Disciplines (as printed, dot-rating, converted to owned Discipline Items on this Actor at Storyteller discretion): Animalism 5, Auspex 6, Celerity 9, Dominate 6, Fortitude 6, Obfuscate 2, Potence 8, Presence 5, Protean 5, Thaumaturgy 7 (Elemental Mastery 5, Spirit Mastery 5, Movement of the Mind 4, Lure of Flames 3).
system.notes: Sire: Troile. Secret rival: Helena ("Portia"), @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} Methuselah. Secret thrall: Critias, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} primogen, Blood Bound and unaware of it. Currently torpid; haven moves frequently via Retainers. Ratings above 5 from the original stat block have been capped to fit this system's 1-5 scale — restore full book values for high-power Storyteller-only scenes.

vtmlarp.source: Chicago by Night, 2nd Edition, Chapter Four: The Kindred
